decisions.reason: Uses the symptom log and contrast probe: tab claimed and titled, meta.status stuck at none while file-trace RPC reads the same file; localizes to the workspace-files provider/Remote chain, rules out disk and renderer, and notes the declared host row yet non-answering service.

Correctly treats the per-module sweep as valid and the oversized joined 404 as a method artifact, but claims the loader fetches each module individually rather than recognizing bounded combo partitioning under a URL limit, and does not address the 60 versus 62 count discrepancy.

Separates the paste-input fold warnings as an independent plugin issue and explains textpreview to documentpreview with session-only canOpen accounting for the absolute-address claim error but not the stalled session tab.

Rejects retry, rewrite and fallback; orders full restart, then rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2 per the discussion, then upstream report; treats the alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art given the clean per-module sweep.

Forensics list covers versions and profile history, addresses and symptom, roster, valid sweep with join caveat, contrast and meta.status; proposes a boot-time workspace-files Remote round-trip check and provider-backing cross-check.
